name: wedding-steeja-arjun

scripts.//prepare: Points git at .githooks, which holds the pre-commit secret guard. npm runs this automatically after `npm install`, so a fresh clone is protected without anyone remembering to opt in. Safe to run repeatedly; the `|| true` keeps a tarball install or a non-git checkout from failing.
scripts.//verify: Asserts every internal link and asset in dist/ resolves at the deploy root, with no doubled path and no host the site used to live on. Run it after a clean build, before pushing to a new host — the failure it catches renders a page that looks merely unstyled.
scripts.//motion: Reads the BUILT css back and checks every animation and transition declaration in it. Catches the mistake of declaring an animation unconditionally and undoing it inside a `reduce` block, which still runs wherever the query is unsupported. Fails the run on an ungated animation or an ungated transition of a geometric property; lists pure crossfades rather than failing them. It does NOT check start states — an ungated `opacity: 0` is still a job for a reader.
scripts.//weight: What each page costs in JavaScript, counting `is:inline` scripts — which ship inside the HTML and are invisible to a `du` on dist/_astro — alongside the bundles. Raw and gzipped, per page, with the admin bundle kept separate because no guest downloads it.
scripts.//brand: Regenerates the link-preview card, the favicons, the touch icon and the manifest from the photo, the palette and the display font. Outputs are committed, so a deploy never runs this — re-run it after changing any of those three.

//overrides: @tailwindcss/vite accepts vite 5-8 and npm hoists the newest, which leaves two copies of Vite in the tree and two incompatible sets of Plugin types. Astro pins ^6, so everything is held there.
